Open Sky House Germany, April 18th 2018

Andrew Cohen in dialogue with John David

Andrew was recently interviewed by John David at Open Sky House in Germany for his satTV website.

In this beautiful dialogue, John and Andrew speak in depth about Andrew's teaching of Evolutionary Enlightenment. They each share from their own life and teaching experience about the nature of Truth and Consciousness, and Andrew takes questions at the end.
